$comment: Every piece the kits ship, once. Groups: brand, site, content, app.
lab / svelte: the story id that shows the piece in that Storybook (null when it has no story of its own).
astro: the piece's anchor in the astro-app /kit gallery.
svelteItem / astroItem: the piece's registry item name in that kit's registry.
'not yet' marks a field whose plan is still in progress; check:parity skips it until then.
A piece with svelteFile 'not yet' doesn't exist at all yet (the app blocks before their phase); the whole piece is skipped.
